# GoldArmy AI

## What is GoldArmy AI

GoldArmy AI is a French-language AI-powered career platform that accelerates job search through a suite of autonomous agents. It targets French-speaking job seekers who want to move faster, apply smarter, and prepare better for interviews.

The platform is available as a web application (Vue.js SPA) and a mobile application (React Native / Expo).

## Core Features

**Sniper Search**
AI agent that scans 50+ job sources simultaneously. Filters and ranks results by relevance to the user's CV and target profile. Delivers only high-signal job leads, not raw listings.

**Mentor IA / CV Audit**
Uploads a PDF CV, extracts text via PyMuPDF, and runs an AI audit against a specific job description. Returns an ATS score, keyword gaps, and a rewrite proposal. Generates a reformatted PDF from 8 visual templates (GoldArmy, Minimaliste, Executive, Creatif, Classique, Neon Tech, Scandinave, Timeline).

**Interview Simulation**
Simulates a real job interview using the Gemini LLM. Speaks back audio responses. Scores answers on clarity, relevance, and confidence. Stores session history for review.

**CRM Kanban**
Tracks job applications through a drag-and-drop pipeline: To Apply, Sent, Interview, Follow-up, Offer, Rejected. Auto-generates follow-up emails via AI. Imports job listings directly from a URL.

**Network / Reseaux**
Contact address book for networking. Finds HR decision-makers and recruiters at target companies via LinkedIn scraping. Drafts outreach emails via Gemini.

**Analytics Dashboard**
Real-time KPIs pulled from live user data: applications sent, CV audits, interviews obtained, network contacts. Growth chart, status distribution, and global job-search score.

**Free Tools (no login required)**
- Free CV Roast: paste CV text, get immediate AI feedback
- Free Interview: one-shot interview simulation without account

## Pricing

Freemium model. Free tier includes limited usage per tool category. Pro tier removes caps and unlocks all features.

## Technology

- Backend: Python, FastAPI, MongoDB Atlas, Playwright (PDF rendering), Gemini / OpenRouter LLMs
- Web frontend: Vue 3 SPA
- Mobile: React Native, Expo 54, Zustand, Axios
- Auth: JWT (access token 7 days, refresh token 30 days), Google OAuth, Apple OAuth

## Target Audience

French-speaking job seekers, students, career changers, and professionals in France, Canada (Quebec), Belgium, and francophone Africa.

## Authenticated Pages

- /home — Post-login dashboard hub

- /mentor — CV audit and rewrite workspace
- /interview — Live interview simulation
- /interview/history — Past sessions
- /crm — Application tracking Kanban
- /network — Contact book and HR finder
- /dashboard — Analytics and KPIs
